bins.name: Food waste
bins.accepts: Food scraps, tea bags and coffee grounds. No packaging or drinks

bins.name: Cans, plastic & cartons
bins.accepts: Cans, foil, plastic bottles, pots and trays, drinks cartons

bins.name: Coffee cups
bins.accepts: Empty paper drinks cups, lids off

bins.name: Small electricals & batteries
bins.accepts: Anything with a plug, battery or cable, 50 cm or smaller

bins.name: General waste
bins.accepts: Anything that can't go in the other bins

prep: Spray paint or part-full cans: ask staff
aerosol_can.why: Empty steel and aluminium aerosols go with cans. Spray paint and part-full cans don't.

prep: Scrunch clean foil into a ball
aluminum_foil.why: Aluminium foil and foil food trays are collected with cans.

prep: Tape the ends of lithium and button batteries
Never put batteries in general waste
battery.why: Batteries go with small electricals. Lithium batteries in general waste start serious fires.

blister_pack.why: Blister packs for tablets are listed as not accepted with plastics.

prep: Greasy or plastic-coated card goes in general waste
cardboard.why: Paper and card must be collected separately in every Welsh workplace.

carton.why: Drinks cartons are part of the cans, plastic and cartons stream.

cigarette_butt.why: Cigarette ends don't belong in any of the recycling streams.

drinking_glass_ceramic.why: Drinking glasses, crockery and ceramics are excluded from glass recycling and go in general waste.

electronics.why: Small electricals have had to be collected separately in Welsh workplaces since April 2026.

foam.why: Polystyrene and foam packaging are excluded from plastic recycling.

prep: Pour drinks into a sink, not this bin
food_scraps.why: Food waste must be collected separately, and none of it may go down the drain.

prep: Lids and caps go with cans
glass_bottle_jar.why: Only glass bottles and jars go in the glass stream.

prep: Lab or clinical items: use the lab's own bin
mask_gloves.why: Masks and gloves have no recycling stream. Clinical or hazardous waste has its own route.

metal_can.why: Steel and aluminium tins and cans are collected with plastic and cartons.

prep: Lids, caps and bottle tops only
metal_lid_scrap.why: Metal lids and bottle tops go with cans. Cutlery, pots and pans are scrap metal, not packaging.

cases.label: Lid, cap or bottle top
prep: Lids, caps and bottle tops only

cases.label: Cutlery, pots, pans or other scrap metal
prep: Ask staff whether scrap metal is collected

paper.why: Clean paper is a required recycling stream. Receipts, sticky notes and tissues are not accepted.

paper_bag.why: Clean paper bags go with paper and card. Greasy ones go in general waste.

paper_cup.why: Plastic-lined paper cups are recycled like cartons, so this station keeps them apart. Cups marked compostable are not accepted.

prep: Scrape leftover food into food waste
pizza_box.why: Card with food or grease on it can't be recycled with paper.
pizza_box.ask: Is the box greasy, or is food stuck to it?

cases.label: Clean or nearly clean
prep: Scrape leftover food into food waste

cases.label: Greasy, or food stuck to it
prep: Scrape leftover food into food waste
Tear off a clean lid for paper and card

plastic_bag_film.why: Plastic bags and film are excluded from plastic recycling.

plastic_bottle.why: Plastic bottles are accepted, unless the plastic is black.

prep: Film lids go in general waste
plastic_container.why: Plastic pots, tubs and trays are accepted, except black trays, foam and compostable plastic.

cases.label: Clear or coloured pot, tub or tray
prep: Film lids go in general waste

plastic_cup.why: Clear plastic cups are accepted. Foam and compostable cups are not.

prep: Leave it on the bottle, or put it in loose
plastic_lid_cap.why: Rigid plastic lids and caps are accepted. Polystyrene drinks-cup lids and thin film lids are not.

cases.label: Rigid bottle cap or tub lid
prep: Leave it on the bottle, or put it in loose

cases.label: Coffee-cup lid or thin film lid

plastic_utensil_straw.why: Plastic cutlery and straws have no recycling stream, and Wales has banned supplying most of them.

rope_string.why: String and rope don't belong in any of the recycling streams.

shoes.why: Shoes have no workplace recycling stream. Wearable pairs are better donated.

snack_wrapper.why: Crisp packets and sweet wrappers are excluded from plastic recycling.

soiled_paper.why: Tissues, paper towels and greasy paper are excluded from paper recycling.

squeezable_tube.why: Most tubes have a metal layer or mixed plastics, which plastic recycling can't take.

textile.why: Only unsold stock has a textile stream at work. Clothes you own are better donated.

prep: Large amounts: ask the grounds team
yard_waste.why: Garden waste isn't one of the workplace recycling streams.
